caseNameFull: Nostrand v. Balmer, as the Board of Regents of the University of Washington
attorneys: John J. O’Connell, Attorney General of Washington, on the motion.

opinions.text: Appeal from the Supreme Court of Washington. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 361 U. S. 873.) The motion to substitute Herbert Little as a party appellee in the place of Thomas Balmer, deceased, is granted.
